svg.title: Background replay cost more in this workload
svg.desc: Seven observed write-and-drain times per policy and language, with diamond medians, on the same zero-to-250-millisecond axis in both panels. Go medians: journal only 124.95 milliseconds, eager table 122.62, background 171.70. Rust medians: 116.19, 111.68, 157.94. Background median elapsed time is about 40 percent higher than eager in both implementations, with overlapping observed ranges. These are local buffered-write experiments, not synchronized throughput or a general language ranking. Vertical dot offsets separate overlapping samples and have no data meaning.

svg.text: Background replay cost more in this workload
Two million buffered records per run. Points are the retained measurements.
Write + drain (ms), same scale in both panels
M3 Max, 16 cores, 128 GiB RAM; macOS 26.6.2; internal APFS.
32-byte records, batches of 64, 4,096 keys. Normal filesystem caching.
Buffered writes only. Excludes queries, recovery and worker stop/join.
